title: Mayflower
description: Create a moving glass platform beneath your feet that follows your horizontal movements!
body:
Create a moving glass platform beneath your feet that follows your horizontal movements!

Utilizes 2 keybinds for this mod which can be configured using controls. 
- Keybind 1 sets the platform y-level to be below your feet.
- Keybind 2 makes the platform y-level disappear.
